SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No. Misc. 214/36
B. D. 7521
Kashing Road Station, 10 36
Date October 6th, 10 36

Subject Activities of National flag-sellers.

Made by D.S.I. Black Forwarded by R. L. Tabrum, Supt.
R. L. T. D.

Sir,
At 11.30 a.m. 5-10-36 F.S. Kurlansky in charge of a walking
search party, was patrolling East Hanbury Road and on approaching
No. 315 (basket shop) noticed three persons, two of whom were
dressed in Sun Yet sen suits and wearing peaked caps, attempting
to sell National flags to the shop-master, Wong Kwei Fah. In
view of the recent memo issued, No. 21/36, F.S. Kurlansky brought
all parties to the station.
On being questioned by D.S.I. Yao Yuen Loong and the under-
signed the shop master stated that the three men had entered the
shop just prior to the arrival of police and no intimidation had
been used.
The three men who gave their names as Yue Tsoong Liang (俞宗良)
Wo Ching Tsaung (吳正昌) and Wong Nyoh Pau (王玉寶), sales
representatives of a National flag factory situated 18 Taiwan
Road, were released after being cautioned as to their method of
forcing sales.

D.S.I. Black
D. S. I.

S. Batty
D.D.O. "C".

S. i

日期：1936年10月6日

事由：国旗售卖者的活动。

由副巡官布莱克（Black）撰写，经警司 R. L. Tabrum 转呈
R. L. T. D.

先生：
1936年10月5日上午11时30分，负责徒步搜查队的警员 F.S. Kurlansky 在巡逻东汉伯里路（East Hanbury Road）时，接近315号（一家篮筐店），注意到有三个人，其中两人身穿中山装并戴着尖顶帽，正试图向店主黄桂发（Wong Kwei Fah，音译）出售国旗。鉴于最近发布的第21/36号备忘录，F.S. Kurlansky 将所有相关人员带至捕房。
在接受副巡官姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong，音译）及本人的讯问时，店主表示，这三名男子是在警察到达之前刚刚进入店内的，且未使用任何胁迫手段。
这三名男子自报姓名为俞宗良（Yue Tsoong Liang）、吴正昌（Wo Ching Tsaung）和王玉宝（Wong Nyoh Pau），系位于台湾路18号的一家国旗工厂的销售代表。在对他们强行推销的行为提出警告后，三人被释放。

副巡官 布莱克

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch xxxxx
REPORT
Date September 8, 1936.

Subject Sale of Standard Party and National Flags in the Settlement.

Made and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore

The Shanghai Committee of Standard Party and National
Flags of the Shanghai City Government have an office in the
Settlement at 18 Taiwan Road (Louza District) with one Dz
Tseng-ming (池振民) in charge, and a staff of 20 clerks.

With reference to attached report Yangtsepoo Misc.
No.218/36 dated September 7, Dz Tseng-ming was called to
Police Headquarters (Special Branch) in the matter, who
explained that the selling of flags in the Settlement is in
the hands of the San Sing Cotton and Iron Factory, 549 Nanking
Road, who receive 25% commission on sales.

Dz Tseng-ming was informed that any further incidents
of pressure being brought to bear on prospective purchasers
would result in the prohibition of the sale of flags in the
Settlement.

FILE
JR

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期：1936年9月8日。

事由：租界内标准党旗和国旗的销售。

由副巡官摩尔（Moore）撰写并转呈

上海市政府标准党旗国旗上海委员会在租界娄家区（Louza District，音译）台湾路18号设有办事处，由池振民（Dz Tseng-ming）负责，配有职员20名。

参照附件中1936年9月7日的杨树浦杂项报告第218/36号，就此事传唤池振民至警务处总部（特别班），他解释说，租界内的旗帜销售由南京路549号的三星棉铁厂（San Sing Cotton and Iron Factory）负责，该厂从销售额中抽取25%的佣金。

已告知池振民，若再发生向潜在买家施压的事件，将禁止在租界内销售旗帜。

归档
JR

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Miso File No... 218/36.
Yangtsepoo Station,
REPORT
Date.... Sept.. 7th,... 19 36.

Subject.... Unauthorized sale of National Standard flags in Eastern
District.

Made by....... D.S. Ieya ................................ Forwarded by [Signature] ........ Inept. O. i/c

Sir,
At 1.45 p.m. 7/9/36, C.P.C. 543 brought to Station three
male Chinese. (1) Mah Liang Shi (馬良溪), 30, Changchow,
W/flag-seller, residing country house of Hart Road, (2) Sze
Ching Loong (施金龍), 40, Kiangsu, W/coolie, residing
Yangtsepoo Social Centre, Yangtsepoo Road, (3) Tseng Yue Tseh
(諸有則) 18, Changchow, S/shop assistant, residing 1709
Yangtsepoo Road, where he is now residing with a female named
Yue Hwo Sz (俞夏氏), 25, Kiangsu, W/shop mistress, 1637
Yangtsepoo Road.

Enquiries by undersigned and C.P.C. 90 ascertained the
following:-

The 1st above named person is a representative of the
National Flag Sales Promotion Commission of Shanghai Municipality
(上海市党國旗劃一推行委員會) and together with the 2nd and 3rd
above named persons, were offering for sale to various shop
keepers in the Eastern District the standard National flags.
The 2nd and 3rd named persons were instructed to accompany the
representative by one named Wang Teh Fang (王德芳), committee
member of the 19th branch of Citizens Federation, Yangtsepoo
Social Centre.

At about 1.30 p.m. 7/9/36, the trio approached a small
cigarette shop situated at 1637 Yangtsepoo Road, with a view
of selling the owner of this shop a standard National flag.
Yue Hwo Sz (俞夏氏), the only inmate of the shop at this
time refused to purchase a flag, and on being told by Mah Liang
Shi (馬良溪) that she must purchase a standard flag, an
argument ensued, with the result that C.P.C. 543 appeared on
the scene and brought all concerned to the Station.

先生：
1936年9月7日下午1时45分，华捕543号将三名中国男子带至捕房。(1) 马良溪（Mah Liang Shi），30岁，常州人，职业：旗帜销售员，居住于赫德路（Hart Road）乡间住宅，(2) 施金龙（Sze Ching Loong），40岁，江苏人，职业：苦力，居住于杨树浦路杨树浦社会中心，(3) 诸有则（Tseng Yue Tseh），18岁，常州人，职业：店员，居住于杨树浦路1709号，目前与一名名叫俞夏氏（Yue Hwo Sz）的女子同住，该女子25岁，江苏人，职业：店主妇，住址为杨树浦路1637号。

经本人及华捕90号查询，查明如下情况：

上述第一人为上海市党国旗帜划一推行委员会的代表，他与上述第二、第三人一起，向东区的各家店主兜售标准国旗。第二和第三人是由杨树浦社会中心市民联合会第十九支部委员王德芳（Wang Teh Fang）指派陪同该代表的。

1936年9月7日下午1时30分左右，这三人走近位于杨树浦路1637号的一家小烟纸店，意图向该店店主出售一面标准国旗。当时店内唯一的在场人员俞夏氏拒绝购买旗帜，当马良溪告诉她必须购买标准旗帜时，双方发生争执，导致华捕543号赶到现场，并将所有相关人员带至捕房。

    Ma. Liang Shi ( 馬良澤 ) admits that between 10 a.m.

July 9, 1936.

- 4 -

At 9 a.m. July 8, three representatives of the
workers, who number fifty, called at the Bureau of Social
Affairs and requested assistance. An official of the
Bureau who received the visitors promised to conduct an
investigation.

Tai Lung Silk Filature - strike

On July 7, three hundred workers of the Tai Lung
Silk Filature, 530 Changan Road, Chapei, went on strike
as a protest against a decision of the management to reduce
their daily wages from 48 to 40 cents. These workers were
still out this morning.

Miscellaneous

Chinese authorities and local public bodies to inspect
national and party flags in Chinese controlled territory

With a view to enforcing the standardization of
national and party flags in Shanghai, representatives of
the Shanghai Municipality National Flag Standardization
Promotion Committee, 32 Rue Wagner, and the Chinese
authorities will inspect national and party flags on display
in Chinese controlled territory to-day, July 9. Flags
other than those issued by the Party and National Flag
Sales and Manufacturing Bureau will be confiscated and
those shop owners and residents who are not in possession
of standardized flags will be advised to purchase same
from date.
page_data.zh:
1936年7月9日。

- 4 -

7月8日上午9时，五十名工人的三名代表前往社会局请求援助。接待来访者的社会局官员承诺进行调查。

泰隆丝厂——罢工

7月7日，位于闸北长安路530号的泰隆丝厂三百名工人举行罢工，抗议管理层决定将其日工资从48美分降至40美分。今天上午这些工人仍在罢工中。

杂项

中国当局和地方公共团体将在中国管辖领土检查党旗和国旗

为了在上海推行党旗和国旗的标准化，上海市党国旗划一推行委员会（办公地点：华格纳路32号）的代表和中国当局将于今天，7月9日，检查在中国管辖领土内展示的党旗和国旗。除由党旗国旗销售制造局发行的旗帜外，其他旗帜将被没收，并建议那些没有标准化旗帜的店主和居民从即日起购买。

page_data.en:
July 8, 1936.

- 3 -

Chung Hwa National Goods Maintenance Association

On July 7, the Chung Hwa National Goods Maintenance
Association, 51 Kwo Tung Road, Nantao, received a
notification from the local Customs informing them that
consignments of cloth manufactured by the Dah Sing (大新)
Cloth Factory at Tientsin detained by the Customs on
suspicion of being smuggled goods had been released.

Sale of Standardized Flags - to be enforced in
Chinese controlled territory

On July 7, the local Bureau of Public Safety
distributed copies of a notice to residents in the area
under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai City Government.
The notice contains an instruction of the Mayor to the
effect that all shops and residences (along streets only)
should hoist standardized national and party flags on
July 9 in commemoration of the Anniversary of the
Commencement of the anti-Northern Expedition (1926).
It also states that officials will be detailed to make
a general inspection on that date, and instructs those
residents and shop owners who are not in possession of
flags to purchase them from the police stations in
Chinese controlled territory.

1936年7月8日。

- 3 -

中华国货维持会

7月7日，位于南市国通路51号的中华国货维持会收到当地海关的通知，告知其此前因涉嫌走私而被海关扣留的天津大新布厂生产的布料货物已被放行。

强制在中国管辖领土销售标准化旗帜

7月7日，当地公安局向上海市政府辖区内的居民分发了通知副本。该通知包含市长的指示，大意是所有商店和住宅（仅限沿街）应在7月9日悬挂标准化党旗和国旗，以纪念北伐开始（1926年）周年纪念日。通知还指出，届时将派遣官员进行全面检查，并指示那些没有旗帜的居民和店主从中国管辖领土内的警察局购买旗帜。

page_data.en:
May 25, 1936.

Shanghai Municipality National Flag Standardization
Promotion Committee - new body formed

A new body known as the Shanghai Municipality National
Flag Standardization Promotion Committee (上海市党国旗划推行委员会)
has been formed with an office at 32 Rue d'Amer. The
committee consists of representatives of seventeen official
and public bodies including the local Kuomintang, Shanghai
City Government, China Aviation League, Bureau of Education,
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters, Bureau of Social Affairs, Bureau
of Public Safety, Chinese Ratepayers' Associations of the
two Settlements and the 1st and 2nd Special District
Citizens' Federations.
page_data.zh:
1936年5月25日。

上海市党国旗划一推行委员会——新机构成立

一个名为“上海市党国旗划一推行委员会”的新机构已经成立，办公地点设在亚美路32号。该委员会由十七个官方和公共团体的代表组成，包括当地国民党、上海市政府、中国航空协会、教育局、中国商会、吴淞上海卫戍司令部、社会局、公安局、两个租界的华人纳税会以及第一和第二特区市民联合会。
